description: React component for a sidebar menu in a dashboard, utilizing Ant Design components and icons, with role-based menu filtering and URL path handling.

classes.name: SidebarProps
classes.description: Props for Sidebar2 component, including access token, user role, default selected key, and collapsed state.

classes.name: MenuItemCfg
classes.description: Configuration for menu items, including key, page, label, roles, children, and icon.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Constructs the base URL path considering environment variables and server root path.

methods.name: routeFor
methods.description: Maps legacy page IDs to relative application routes.

methods.name: toHref
methods.description: Generates full URL href from a slug or path, combining base path and route.
